title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 27
paragraphs: These too are known. But as to the region beyond them, it is the Issedonians who report that there are one-eyed men there and gold-guarding griffins; and the Scythians, having received this from them, report it in turn; and from the Scythians we—that is, the rest of mankind—have got our belief. We call them in Scythian Arimaspians, for the Scythians call the number one arima and the eye spu.
